name: ai-chatbot-builder
description: Multi-tenant AI chatbot builder: dashboard, API server, and embeddable widget

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,widget -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w widget"
scripts.build: npm run build -w widget && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w widget
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w widget
